name: v2-laser-raster
review: The 12 alternating 20 mm scans and 12 quarter-millimetre advances give the recorded directions, steps and final position. Source-defined 90-degree junctions give 3.4743 mm/s; independent tick-rounded calculations reproduce the four distinct first, middle and final move timings within one 10 microsecond tick. Both real firmware revisions reproduced the trace. This tests motion and command acceptance only; the trace does not validate laser PWM, emitted power or physical-board timing.
